confirmed_findings.title: Right after 'Swap it' merges the V60 + cake into the Afternoon Set, the cart re-suggests adding the saffron cake it just removed
Placing an order never clears the cart, so the new 'welcome back — your usual?' strip can never appear for a real returning customer and stale carts resurface

smartSuggestHtml dereferences flagship item ids without guards (byId["colombia"].price, byId["dateplate"].price) and hardcodes the cake price as 24 — kit-personalized client demos crash renderCart, making 'View order' dead
Turning Ramadan mode off doesn't survive a reload when the URL carries ?ramadan=1 — the stored '0' is ignored
Owner Mode 'Scans by hour' axis is hardcoded English ('6am/12pm/6pm/12am') and mislabels the 24-cell heat row
'wasm-last-order' is loaded without the shape validation applied to the cart — a corrupt value makes renderUsual throw inside applyLang and aborts the whole boot under the intro overlay
Cart is never cleared after ordering — 'your usual' strip is unreachable organically, stale cart on return, and the rescue toast nags right after every order
Owner Mode heat-chart axis labels are hardcoded English ('6am/12pm/6pm/12am') — violates the bilingual t() hard rule
Inconsistent numeral systems for money and counts in the same view (locNum vs bare Western numerals)
Owner Mode 'scans by hour' has 24 hourly buckets under an 18-hour (6am–12am) axis — the histogram misplaces traffic and contradicts the demo's own story
Owner Mode bar-fill growth animation ignores prefers-reduced-motion (hard rule for new animations)
om-dot glow hardcodes the flagship gold rgba, escaping the palette-token pipeline kit/new-client.mjs depends on
New rmBtn aria-label 'Ramadan mode' is hardcoded English and never localized
Demo iframe is off-center in the 'good' phone frame — 46px dead strip on the inline-start side
Green 'Menu Sadah' phone label overlays and blocks the live demo's header controls inside the interactive frame
QR promises 'scan to see a live menu' but encodes the marketing site root, not the demo menu
anaTry hint says triple-tap 'the وَسْم wordmark' but only the small header wordmark is wired — the big hero وَسْم does nothing
Owner Mode dialog (aria-modal) never receives, traps, or restores focus — and stays keyboard-reachable after closing
Owner Mode bar-growth animation ignores prefers-reduced-motion (project hard rule)
Ramadan toggle: hardcoded English-only aria-label never localized, and no aria-pressed state
Owner Mode hour-axis labels are hardcoded English-only strings (hard-rule violation)
Offline navigate fallback serves the flagship WASM demo for any uncached page, including kit-generated client demos
